Former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee addresses TMC rally in Kolkata
The Hindu
2089999 subscribers
477 likes
29854 views
21 Jul 2026
Former West Bengal Chief Minister and TMC leader Mamata Banerjee, addressing a party rally in Kolkata, launched a sharp attack on the BJP, accusing it of political intimidation, misuse of investigative agencies and attempts to weaken the Trinamool Congress. She asserted that the party would intensify its agitation from Kolkata to the districts, urged workers to remain united and called on Opposition parties to strengthen anti-BJP unity in West Bengal. Banerjee also reaffirmed her faith in the judiciary and appealed to supporters to continue democratic protests despite administrative hurdles.
